project_name: Pomi - Premium Period Tracking Concept Exploration
app_type: Concept Showcase & Design System Portfolio (Frontend Only)

brand_identity.name: Pomi
brand_identity.positioning: Mature, restrained, honest, trustworthy, premium, calm, modern, and emotionally safe cycle tracking for discerning adults.
brand_identity.core_emotional_tone: Warm luxury, quiet privacy, thoughtful health editorial, scientific clarity without clinical coldness.
anti_patterns_to_avoid: No childish illustrations, cartoons, or cute mascots
No overly pink, hyper-girly or juvenile gradients
No cluttered, noisy dashboards or gamified streak badges
No cold, sterile hospital UI or scary medical warnings
No startup neon gradients or generic Vercel dark mode
No emoji characters in UI elements or navigation

interactive_mockup_screens.name: 1. Welcome & Onboarding
interactive_mockup_screens.purpose: Establish trust immediately with clear data privacy commitments (no third-party tracking, zero ad sales) and cycle baseline setup.

interactive_mockup_screens.name: 2. Today's Dashboard
interactive_mockup_screens.purpose: Display current cycle day, phase forecast (Luteal, Follicular, Ovulation, Menstrual), probability ring/bar, and quick symptom logging trigger.

interactive_mockup_screens.name: 3. Cycle Timeline
interactive_mockup_screens.purpose: Provide a clean, elegant phase calendar visualizer showing phase transitions, fertility window, and symptom density history.

interactive_mockup_screens.name: 4. Symptom Log
interactive_mockup_screens.purpose: Allow users to tap symptoms (Flow, Energy, Mood, Physical, Sleep) with interactive intensity selectors, updating live state in localStorage.

interactive_mockup_screens.name: 5. Insights & Trust
interactive_mockup_screens.purpose: Present calm health analysis, hormone pattern correlations, and explain 'Why Pomi is Premium & Trustworthy' (Zero data monetization, offline encryption).

interactive_mockup_screens.name: 6. Settings & Comparison
interactive_mockup_screens.purpose: Settings panel highlighting export options, biometric lock, and explicit comparison of Pomi vs. typical pink juvenile trackers.

layout_and_architecture.structure: Single-page React App with dynamic tab navigation for showcase views:

views.title: Direction Showcase Landing
views.description: Hero section introducing Pomi concept exploration, followed by 3 comprehensive Direction Cards with quick preview links.

views.title: Interactive Direction Explorer
views.description: Left/Center: High-fidelity interactive Mobile Phone Mockup running all 6 screens. Right: Comprehensive Rationale Panel dissecting the typography, color psychology, UX choices, and contrast decisions for that specific direction.

views.title: 3-Direction Side-by-Side Matrix
views.description: Synchronized screen switcher showing the exact same screen (e.g. Symptom Logging or Today's Dashboard) side-by-side across Almanac, Ledger, and Bloom Kit to evaluate layout and tone differences.

accessibility_and_testing.test_id_rules: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, screen switchers, direction cards) MUST have explicit data-testid attributes formatted in kebab-case.
accessibility_and_testing.contrast_standard: All body text and interactive states must pass WCAG AA (4.5:1 minimum ratio). Dark text on light cream or off-white backgrounds; deep crimson/berry for primary CTAs with white text.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid AI slop: maintain clear hierarchy, sophisticated whitespace, and subtle micro-interactions.
Do not import standard Inter font for headlines. Use Playfair Display for Almanac, Space Grotesk for Ledger, and Outfit for Bloom Kit.
Store symptom logging data in browser localStorage so logs persist when switching screens or directions.
Ensure the mobile phone mockup frame responds nicely on desktop and tablet screens.
Include an explicit 'Why Premium & Trustworthy' breakdown modal or section explaining privacy architecture.
